paper_context.title: Deep Learning Approaches for Wildfire Severity Prediction: A Comparative Study of Image Segmentation Networks and Visual Transformers on the EO4WildFires Dataset
paper_context.application: Transfers common-split, antecedent-history, multi-metric, and filtered-training/full-evaluation controls; does not reproduce burned-area segmentation or establish containment validity.

outcome.definition: Containment calendar date more than three days after discovery calendar date; same-day cases remain valid negative examples.

history_provenance.window: Discovery date minus30 through minus1, excluding discovery date; complete consecutive calendar days required.
history_provenance.aggregation: Mean and maximum of daily maximum temperature, VPD, and wind; mean daily maximum is not mean hourly temperature/VPD/wind.
history_provenance.spatial_limitation: Existing centroid assignments have median166km and P95348km separation; history does not improve spatial resolution.

fixed_training_config.logistic: Standardized numeric + one-hot categorical, C=1, lbfgs, maximum500 iterations
fixed_training_config.calibration: Each model receives Platt logistic adjustment of clipped raw logits, fitted only on identical2015–2017 rows; raw metrics also reported.

selection.interpretation: Exploratory validation screen, not automatic replacement or production promotion; confidence intervals ignore model-selection multiplicity and cross-day serial dependence.

caveats: This is an exploratory repeated benchmark: validation and2023–2024 outcomes were already inspected in previous work; reassessment is not an untouched confirmatory future test.
Model selection is frozen from2018–2019 before computing2023–2024 benchmark metrics; reassessment never changes that selection.
Feature ablations measure conditional predictive contribution in this setup, not causal weather/load effects or suppression-capacity attribution.
Final acreage and observed concurrency are retrospective and outcome-related; daily maximum weather includes conditions after discovery. These are not dispatch-time forecasts.
Prior30 history excludes discovery-day weather but uses the same broad regional centroids; local-day alignment remains approximate because source clock timezones are unspecified.
Reporting completeness changes sharply by agency/year; the selected containment cohort is not representative by default. Forest Service is not a stable coverage control.
Filtering training to>=1acre is a distinct sensitivity, not removal of empty segmentation labels; same-day cases are retained in every fitting regime.
Outcome-conditioned same-day/prolonged diagnostics are single-class; no binary classification performance metrics are reported for them.
The separate candidate artifact contains only a probability classifier and requires a separate adapter; it does not replace main quantile/duration models.
Paired discovery-day bootstrap intervals omit across-day dependence and selection multiplicity; candidate eligibility does not establish reproducible future improvement.

reference_baselines.definition: Constant probability fixed to the 2015–2017 calibration-sample positive fraction; no validation/reassessment fitting.

metric_definitions.average_precision: Noninterpolated average precision; prevalence is the constant-score reference, so values across different populations are not directly comparable.
metric_definitions.roc_auc: ROC area; ranking discrimination, independent of a fixed classification threshold.
metric_definitions.brier_score: Mean squared probability error; lower is better. Compare with fixed-rate baseline as well as other fitted models.
metric_definitions.expected_calibration_error: Sample-weighted absolute observed-minus-predicted rate in ten equal-width probability bins. Coarse bins can conceal within-bin errors; this alone does not prove calibration.

benchmark_artifact_snapshot.scope: Whole-file SHA-256 matched at the start and end of this benchmark execution. It is a historical snapshot, not a claim about the current artifact after later authorized support-gate metadata changes.

original_estimator_integrity.scope: Original probability classifier, old Platt calibrator, and all-fire quantile estimators compared directly with the preserved source artifact. The audited recent calibration, prolonged-duration models, and support-gate objects are separate components.
